JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Boris, Ciara, Drew, Octavio, Tara, Vicente

payload.content: My strongest fit is ISSUE-0002 frontend/documentation work, especially review (and possibly test). I’ll likely take ISSUE-0002::review in execution; please coordinate other agents onto distinct tasks to maximize completions and avoid duplicate claims.

I have strongest documentation skill. Drew indicates he plans ISSUE-0002::review. To avoid duplication, I can take ISSUE-0002::test (critical, cost 5.28) unless another agent has a stronger fit/plan there. Please coordinate remaining agents onto distinct feasible tasks; I will not commit until execution.

Drew plans ISSUE-0002::review and Boris plans ISSUE-0002::test. To complete the critical set and avoid overlap, I can take ISSUE-0002::implement (feasible at effort 4h within my 7h availability), though my private cost is high; please let me know if another agent is better suited/claiming it. Otherwise I’ll likely take it in execution. My low-cost alternatives are ISSUE-0001::triage/docs/review.

I can cover a distinct remaining task. My strongest fit is documentation/frontend, but ISSUE-0002 review/test/implement are already tentatively covered by Drew/Boris/Tara. I can take ISSUE-0001::triage if no one else has claimed it; please coordinate remaining agents onto distinct ISSUE-0001 tasks. I’ll wait until execution to commit.

I can cover ISSUE-0001::triage (medium, low effort) to keep distinct from the proposed critical ISSUE-0002 assignments. Please coordinate remaining agents onto other unclaimed tasks; I’ll commit only in execution.

I have strong mobile-development fit and will plan to take ISSUE-0001::implement (cost 4.28, within availability). Drew/Boris/Tara’s critical ISSUE-0002 review/test/implement plan is noted. Ciara and Vicente are both proposing ISSUE-0001::triage, so please split: one takes triage, the other takes a distinct mobile task (review/docs/test). That yields six nonduplicate assignments.

Confirming my likely choice remains ISSUE-0002::review (critical, low private cost/strong frontend fit). For six distinct claims, let Vicente take ISSUE-0001::triage and Ciara choose another unclaimed mobile task; please keep any other assignments non-overlapping and feasible.

Confirming I will reserve ISSUE-0002::test for execution (critical, feasible within my 4h availability, cost 5.28). Drew review and Tara implement are distinct. Please ensure others choose unique feasible tasks; Vicente has triage and Ciara another mobile task as discussed.

Potential cost improvement: my private cost for ISSUE-0002::implement is 8.79 despite feasibility, while my mobile fit makes ISSUE-0001::review/docs far cheaper (1.92 each). Ciara has indicated strong documentation/frontend fit, so she may be a better-cost owner for ISSUE-0002::implement. If Ciara can take that, I can take a distinct remaining ISSUE-0001 task (review or docs), while Octavio keeps implement and Vicente triage; ensure we preserve six unique assignments. Please coordinate based on your private costs. I will not commit during planning.

I can take ISSUE-0002::implement in execution: my private cost is 4.62 (critical, feasible, strong documentation/frontend match), improving on Tara’s stated 8.79. Drew review, Boris test, Octavio mobile implement, and Vicente triage remain distinct. Tara should take a distinct low-cost ISSUE-0001 task (docs or review; she reported 1.92), leaving six unique feasible assignments. I will not commit until execution.

Confirming my planned choice is ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 1.51), distinct from Drew’s ISSUE-0002::review. On the public coordination channel, Ciara has offered ISSUE-0002::implement, Boris test, Octavio ISSUE-0001::implement, and Tara can take a remaining mobile review/docs task; please keep assignments unique. I’ll wait until execution to commit.

Confirming I will take ISSUE-0001::implement in execution (cost 4.28, feasible, strong mobile fit). Current coordinated set is unique and feasible: Drew→ISSUE-0002::review, Boris→ISSUE-0002::test, Ciara→ISSUE-0002::implement, Vicente→ISSUE-0001::triage, me→ISSUE-0001::implement, and Tara→one of ISSUE-0001::review/docs (equal stated cost). Please preserve these distinct claims.

I’ll retain ISSUE-0002::review for execution (critical, feasible, private cost 2.16). Current public coordination has Ciara on ISSUE-0002::implement, Boris on ::test, Octavio on ISSUE-0001::implement, Vicente on ::triage; Tara can choose an unclaimed low-cost mobile task. Please keep claims distinct.

I confirm my execution choice is ISSUE-0002::test (critical, feasible at 2.8h within 4h; private cost 5.28). Current coordinated unique set looks good: Drew review, Ciara implement, Octavio mobile implement, Vicente triage, Tara remaining mobile docs/review. I will not assign until execution.

The coordinated set is now clear and mutually unique: Drew ISSUE-0002::review, Boris ::test, Ciara ::implement, Octavio ISSUE-0001::implement, Vicente ISSUE-0001::triage. I will take ISSUE-0001::docs (cost 1.92, feasible) in execution, leaving mobile review unclaimed. This yields six feasible unique claims.

Confirming coordinated six-task plan: Drew→ISSUE-0002::review, Boris→ISSUE-0002::test, Ciara→ISSUE-0002::implement, Octavio→ISSUE-0001::implement, Vicente→ISSUE-0001::triage, Tara→ISSUE-0001::docs. I will hold ISSUE-0002::implement for execution; unique and feasible.
Planning confirmation: I’ll take ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 1.51, feasible) in execution. This remains distinct from the other proposed assignments; please keep the remaining claims unique.

Planning confirmation: I will claim ISSUE-0001::implement in execution (4h, cost 4.28, within 9h availability). Planning confirmation: I will take ISSUE-0002::test in execution (critical, 2.8h within my 4h availability; private cost 5.28). This remains distinct from Drew’s review and Ciara’s implement, with the other coordinated assignments unchanged. I will not commit until execution.
